reports.title: Inhibrx Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

desk.headline: Net loss widens to $38.7m ($2.46 a share), slightly worse than expected; no financial guidance
results: Revenue of $2.0m came from a one-off patent licence fee from Pfizer; there was none a year ago.
Research spending fell to $26.0m as the chondrosarcoma trial finished enrolling and headcount dropped.
Admin costs rose to $7.8m on launch preparation for ozekibart in chondrosarcoma.
Interest on the larger $275m loan lifted other expense to $7.0m; net loss widened to $38.7m.

guidance.summary: Inhibrx gives no financial guidance; it lists trial milestones instead.

watch: FDA decision timing on ozekibart in chondrosarcoma and launch readiness.
Updated Ewing sarcoma data at the CTOS meeting on 19–20 Nov 2026.
Ordastobart head and neck and lung cancer readouts, expected around mid-2027.
